broker_identity.explicit_commission_report: User-reported zero; not verified by relevant account specification or sanitized deal history.
broker_identity.identity_rule: Do not silently substitute an XM entity, account type, GOLD contract, symbol, server, or specification.

commission.observed_source: Sanitized relevant-account deal history using DEAL_COMMISSION plus DEAL_FEE; retain deal type and currency.
commission.zero_report_rule: Reported zero remains unverified until relevant account evidence establishes it.

conversion.account_value_formula: abs(delta_price) / tick_size * tick_value * lots; use direction-appropriate profit/loss tick value and account-currency conversion when required.
conversion.denominator_rule: Use each frozen trade's actual initial risk; never realized winner size or average stop distance.
conversion.frozen_trade_risk_binding: initial_risk_price_i = abs(entry_price_i - stop_price_i) from the frozen ledger.
conversion.monetary_risk_requirement: Monetary initial risk additionally requires frozen quantity and verified tick monetary conversion; missing quantity blocks account-unit trade values but not proportional price-distance cost_R.

data_sufficiency_gate.rule: If essential inputs cannot be established defensibly, do not invent them and do not manufacture a net expectancy.
data_sufficiency_gate.waiting_outcome: XAU REAL BROKER COST CALIBRATION: WAITING FOR BROKER COST DATA

decision_authority: Sol/main only; this protocol does not approve or advance a phase

decision_framework.CONDITIONAL: Complete core positive and complete S2 positive but not PASS, including utilization in [0.75, 1), stress threat, or material nonessential uncertainty.
decision_framework.FAIL: Only with complete S2 and net total <= 0 OR expectancy <= 0 OR PF <= 1 OR utilization >= 1.
decision_framework.PASS: Only with complete S2 net total > 0, expectancy > 0, PF > 1, utilization < 0.75, and S3 net total > 0, expectancy > 0, PF > 1.
decision_framework.WAITING: Any essential identity/account/chart-mode/value/commission/swap evidence prevents defensible S2.

directional_confirmation_freeze.rule: Do not inspect strategy economics from this future window; do not use post-cutoff XAU data for directional analysis or bias persistence.

evidence_hierarchy.official_documentation_limit: Generic official documentation cannot substitute account-specific values.
tier_a_direct_observed: actual spread observations on the relevant XM account/server
sanitized order/deal history for commission, swap, requested and executed fills
evidence_hierarchy.tier_c_modelled: MODELLED — NOT OBSERVED; only conservative predeclared assumptions when direct execution observations do not exist.

frozen_historical_validation.rule: Synthetic friction is not a broker-cost measurement; preserve the existing frozen trades and frozen initial-risk R denominator.

no_tuning_statement: The frozen strategy remains unchanged. Costs are applied to existing frozen trades only; no exit rerouting, stop changes, or trade suppression is permitted.

other_execution_inputs.unknown_until_capture: Actual frozen-account/server symbol capture is required for specification values.
other_execution_inputs.volume: No synthetic strategy sizing. Use frozen trade risk; account-unit illustrations use 1.0 lot only after specification verification. Report scaling/rounding separately without suppressing trades.

privacy: Do not commit credentials, account numbers, personal information, or secrets. Sanitize broker exports while retaining reproducible cost evidence.

protocol_lock.amendment_rule: No amendment after net results are seen; a correctness defect stops for Sol review.
protocol_lock.builder_scope: Must not open a trade ledger/raw source or import execution/economic code.

required_reporting.break_even: Recalculate exactly as gross total R / 820; cost-utilization is realistic mean cost R per trade divided by precise break-even R per trade.
required_reporting.directions: LONG and SHORT gross/cost/net attribution only; no filtering or directional recommendation.
required_reporting.order: Chronological closed-trade order; never reorder trades.

scenarios.S1_observed_core: Account-specific executable spread evidence (bid/ask ticks/quotes or fills) plus account-verified commission plus historical swap/deal costs plus observed slippage only; M1 bar-minimum spread may be reported descriptively but cannot complete S1; incomplete if any required component is missing.
scenarios.S2_realistic_execution: S1 plus modelled one verified tick adverse at entry and exit only when observed slippage is missing.
scenarios.S3_conservative_stress: S1 plus modelled 0.5 matched M1 bar-minimum spread adverse at each entry and exit as an explicitly lower-bound-derived stress base.
scenarios.missing_rule: S2/S3 cannot overcome missing essential S1 identity, account, chart mode, executable spread, swap, or verified value specification; all are incomplete and must not manufacture net expectancy.
scenarios.selection_rule: Scenario values are evidence-driven and predeclared; the synthetic break-even is context only and must not choose assumptions.

slippage.observed: Only sanitized orders/deals with direction-correct adverse executed minus request/decision/reference price; report distribution.
slippage.scenario_2: MODELLED — NOT OBSERVED: one verified SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE adverse per side, only when observed slippage is missing.
slippage.scenario_3: MODELLED — NOT OBSERVED: 0.5 * matched M1 bar-minimum spread price adverse at entry and at exit (one additional spread round trip); this is a lower-bound-derived stress base, not observed executable spread.
slippage.stop_gap_rule: Stop execution gaps remain slippage; never reroute exits.

spread.chart_mode_requirement: Actual GOLD SYMBOL_CHART_MODE is required before executable spread attribution.
spread.classification: OBSERVED — M1 BAR-MINIMUM SPREAD, NOT POINT-IN-TIME EXECUTABLE SPREAD
spread.last_or_unknown_chart_mode: Spread application incomplete; no core/net scenario.
spread.limitation: There are no bid/ask levels, quote time, or fill; the minimum is a lower-bound bar statistic that can understate execution spread. Never infer spread from OHLC ranges.
spread.lookup: Previous exact-minute M1 row only: last completed bar strictly before execution timestamp with exact prior-minute adjacency. It is no-lookahead descriptive interval evidence only, not execution-time evidence; gaps are missing with no imputation; a same-timestamp M1 row is the following interval and prohibited.
spread.raw_column_semantics: MqlRates minimum spread per M1 bar in integer MT5 points.

swap_financing.current_vs_historical: CURRENT/OBSERVED SWAP STRUCTURE must remain separate from HISTORICAL SWAP UNKNOWN; do not backfill today's rates across years.
swap_financing.missing_rule: Historical swap unavailable is an essential unknown; scenario incomplete unless a bounded scenario is scientifically defensible and labelled.
